children: Perrette Jean-Briac, an officer serving as Pres.&CEO, Global Streaming, reported a direct sale of Series A common stock at a weighted average price of $28.96 per share. The total sale amount reported was $3,669,434. The reporter disposed of 126,707 shares in the transaction dated 2026-08-27. Following the sale, the reporter directly beneficially owns 1,047,016 shares of Series A common stock. The filing notes the weighted average price reflects multiple transactions at prices ranging from $28.95 to $28.98 per share.
